localEquivalence.result: no existing equivalent; this module is the whole delta

exports.ucTtsAdapter: default TTS adapter instance (TTS_ADAPTERS synthesize contract: synthesize(text, model, credentials, responseFormat, options))
exports.createUcTtsAdapter: factory; options { timeoutMs, mintTimeoutMs, handshakeTimeoutMs, idleTimeoutMs, maxFrameBytes, maxAudioBytes, WebSocketImpl } for tests
exports.buildUcSpeechInput: (model, text, options) -> { model, voice, text }; throws status 400 before any network call
exports.resolveUcCredential: (credentials) -> { clientCookie, sid, uid, cookies } from providerSpecificData, or null
exports.mintUcSessionToken: (credential, { signal, timeoutMs }) -> { ok, jwt } or { ok: false, kind, status? }; never throws
exports.ucMintUrl: Clerk token mint URL for a sid
exports.ucMintHeaders: Clerk mint headers for a cookie jar
exports.runUcTtsSocket: one synthesis; { outcome, sent, audio, usagePercent?, thresholdCrossed?, handshakeStatus? }; never throws
exports.__setUcTtsWebSocketForTesting: swap the WebSocket constructor; returns a restore function
exports.normalizeCookieJar: flat cookie jar from a flat or CDP-shaped record, unsafe entries dropped
exports.cookieHeader: Cookie header value from a jar
exports.uidFromSessionJwt: unverified `uid` claim of a session JWT
exports.ucSecrets: selected connection values for error redaction
exports.UC_TTS_REGISTRY_ENTRY: exact pinned audioRegistry.ts fields and models
exports.UC_PROVIDER_DEFINITION: provider definition for registration (alias, display, category, authType, credential fields, serviceKinds, ttsConfig, models)
